name: 12th Street Players
description: The Twelfth Street Players were founded in 1976 by Eddie Sowa and Freddy Guera in Cicero, Illinois, centered on the intersection of Roosevelt Road (12th Street) and Austin Boulevard at the northern border of Cicero. Comprised mostly of Italian-Americans and later Slavic-Americans, they were members of the People Alliance with close ties to the Chicago Outfit. They expanded into surrounding western suburbs including Berwyn, Lyons, Brookfield, and LaGrange, and engaged in territorial warfare with Folk Nation gangs and former People Alliance allies, including the Latin Kings and Latin Counts, throughout the 1980s and 1990s.
